# Vendored JavaScript

`dagre.min.js` is dagre 0.8.5 (graph layout, MIT licence,
<https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre>), as published on npm
(`dist/dagre.min.js`, sha512 integrity of the package
`/aTqmnRta7x7MCCpExk7HQL2O4owCT2h8NT//9I1OQ9vt29Pa0BzSAkR5lwFUcQ7491yVi/3CXU9jQ5o0Mn2Sw==`).
The bundle contains graphlib and lodash, both MIT. Their licences are
`LICENSE.dagre`, `LICENSE.graphlib` and `LICENSE.lodash`.

The viewer serves these files itself, so the page needs no network access
beyond the robot.
